name: Peter Sperling
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2003-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Peter Sperling stepped down as the chairman of the Apollo Education Group when it was taken private in a $1.1 billion deal in February 2017.
Sperling joined the company in 1983, about a decade after his father founded it.
The for-profit education company became well-known for its online University of Phoenix network.
His father John Sperling, former San Jose State University professor, founded the University of Phoenix in 1973.

name: Carl Ferdinand Oetker
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Carl Ferdinand Oetker and his brother are the co-CEOs and owners of Geschwister Oetker, a German holding company with brands spanning wine and spirits, chemicals and hotels.
Geschwister Oetker was formed in 2021 after the Oetker family agreed to divide their $8 billion (sales) conglomerate into two independent groups.
The original business, Dr. August Oetker, began in 1891 when his great-grandfather started selling non-perishable baking powder.
In September of 2024, he and his brother Alfred bought out their sister Julia from Geschwister Oetker, assuming full control over the company.
He studied economics and international relations at Brown University, then started his career at Boston Consulting Group.
forbes_facts: When Rudolf August passed away in 2007, ownership of Dr. August Oetker was divided between his eight children from three marriages.

name: Gao Mingqing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun China (2025-2026); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Gao Mingqing is the chairman and CEO of Wanguo Gold Group, a China-based mining and processing company.

Wanguo acquired 77.78% of AXF Gold Ridge in the Solomon Islands for AUD39.215 million in April 2020 and another 20.22% for HK$732.6 million in October 2024, strengthening its global gold mining presence.
Wanguo Gold Group listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2012.

name: Sanjay Agarwal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2024); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019); Hurun Unicorn founders (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Sanjay Agarwal is managing director and CEO of the Jaipur-headquartered AU Small Finance Bank.
It serves retail customers as well as small and medium businesses
The chartered accountant set up a finance company in 1996 and converted it into a bank in 2017.
The bank has more than 1,000 branches across India and over four million customers.

name: Xu Qiming
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2017-2020); Hurun Global (2014-2018); Hurun China (2006-2017)
forbes_bio: Xu Qiming made his earliest money in eel farming at his China Xulong Group, one of China's largest eel exporters.
Over the years Xu has built on his eel fortune with one of China's best private art collections.
SInce 2010, Xu has donated at least 6 pieces of art to the National Museum of China.

name: Cristina Green
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2004-2025)
forbes_bio: Cristina Green and her husband Philip Green own the embattled retail empire Arcadia Group, which fell into bankruptcy during the Covid-19 pandemic.
The business was subsequently forced to sell its best-known brands, including Topshop, Top Man and Dorothy Perkins.
Outside of Arcadia, the Greens own three yachts worth about $140 million and nearly $40 million of real estate that Cristina was found to have bought through offshore firms.
The Greens have been vilified in Britain for their role in letting home retailer BHS collapse, which put pensions for 19,000 workers at risk in 2016.

name: David Hoffman
forbes_bio: David Hoffman owns 42 commercial properties in Naples, Florida, making him the biggest developer in the city.
His early fortune came from executive search firm DHR International, which he established in 1989 and still owns.
He and his wife Jerri moved to Naples in 2015 and spent $75 million on their initial purchase of seven buildings and a parking lot on the city's main boulevard, Fifth Avenue South.
Hoffman also owns Herz Arena and the Everblades hockey team, the Old Collier Golf Club and small businesses such as Stan's Coffee and Mitch's Cookies.
Hoffman grew up Washington, Missouri, where his dad drove a milk truck.  The family didn't have running hot water until he was in high school.
forbes_facts: Hoffman and his wife own four wineries and 1250 acres of vineyard in Missouri.

name: Chang Jing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2021-2022); Hurun China U40 (2020-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2022-2026)
forbes_bio: Chang Jing chairs Beijing Roborock Technology, which makes robotic sweeping and mopping devices and handheld cordless stick vacuums.
Chang founded Roborock, which is based in Beijing, in 2014.
Roborock's shareholders include China smartphone heavyweight Xiaomi.
Chang worked for Microsoft, Tencent and Baidu before setting up Roborock.

name: Cao Kejian
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023-2026); Forbes annual (2013-2023); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2011-2026)
forbes_bio: Cao Kejian chairs Zhejiang Kaishan Compressor, China's biggest manufacturer of air compressors and rock drilling equipment.
Cao owns 52% of Zhejiang Kaishan, which went public in 2011 and whose customers  include giant GE.
Cao holds a degree from Zhejiang University of Technology, where he majored in chemical machinery.
